reader.requirement: At --std 85 a program contained (directly or indirectly) in another must reach, as ONE shared storage, every data-name that is global (01-level GLOBAL in Working-Storage or the File Section, a GLOBAL FD's records, and every subordinate data-name and condition-name, X.4.6.4 GR1) in its direct container or any program containing it, and must not reach a container's non-global item, a contained or sibling program's item, or the REDEFINES object of a GLOBAL redefiner (X.4.6.4 GR3).

edition-consulted.switches: GLOBAL in the Linkage Section (Constructs.LinkageGlobal2002): refused COBOL0900 at 85, admitted from 2002

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|CobolVersion|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior over InheritStep.cs, InheritedGlobals.cs, DataBindState.cs, SymbolTable.cs, ForestSlice.cs, LinkageBinder.cs#CallBindExternalAndGlobal and BinderDriver.cs#BindUnitData: the inheritance path itself never consults the edition; the only edition arm on the construct is the Linkage-GLOBAL gate, whose 85 arm (refuse) is what §1985:X.4.6.3 SR1 requires.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 GLOBAL is admitted only on 01 entries in File/Working-Storage, FD and RD (Linkage GLOBAL refused COBOL0900); the sharing mechanism itself is the same at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers two-level indirect sharing of elementary and table items; not exercised there: ODO in a global record, condition-names, signed/edited items, REDEFINES subject-only globality, ref-mod, size error, and the refusal half

probes.printed: IN SIZE ERROR / OUT GN=4 GT=AABBCCDQ / OUT GS=-013.34 GE=- 13.34 / OUT GF-YES / OUT GA=YBCDEZ GBIG=999999999999999999
probes.expected: inner program (two levels in) stores to the outer GLOBAL group's ODO object, ODO table, signed and edited items, 88 condition, the GLOBAL REDEFINES subject (ref-mod at both bounds) and an 18-digit item (size error leaves it): the outer program sees every store
a container's non-global item is not reachable (X.1.3.8.2: names may be referenced only by that program)
a program cannot reference a name declared in a program it contains (X.1.3.8.2)
a sibling's GLOBAL item is not shared (neither program contains the other)
X.4.6.4 GR3: only the subject of a GLOBAL REDEFINES is global; the object GA is not

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: the GLOBAL clause in the linkage section requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: X.4.6.3 SR1: GLOBAL only in File Section / Working-Storage 01 entries, FD, RD

probes.printed: error COBOL2404: ... the GLOBAL clause is not admitted here — this entry's level-number is 77

citations.check: OK  §1985:X.1.3.6 GR2  (1.3.6 Sharing Data)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: Global roots of every container (nearest first, with depth) are offered by InheritStep.Seed, made visible by DataBinder.InheritGlobalSubtree (data-names, 88s, 66s, index-names) and bridged to the container's own storage by InheritStep.Merge, so both programs refer to one item. All probes behaved as the 1985 text requires, including the 85-only refusal of Linkage GLOBAL.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 under E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-031/: r1a_global_rec_nonglobal_fd (an 01 GLOBAL record under a NON-global FD, legal per X.4.6.3 SR1): inner sees OUTR/0001, its stores (INNR, 0042) are seen by the outer and WRITE/READ back INNR 0042: one storage. r1c_external_global (01 EXTERNAL GLOBAL plus a GLOBAL record with an ODO table whose object the inner changes 3->5, ref-mod GT(2:)): OUT EGA=0008 GT=5VWXYZ LEN-CHARS=VWXYZ, then a separately compiled program sharing EG EXTERNAL: EGA=0108. r1b_renames_of_global: a 66 RENAMES of the global record is reachable from the contained program (IN GR=ABCDEF, OUT G=XYZXYZ); the data renamed possesses the global attribute, so X.1.3.6 GR2 sharing is met; whether the 66 NAME is global is a name-scope question (X.1.3.3 'subordinate'), not this rule. r1d_cd_record_global: GLOBAL on an 01 under a CD refused COBOL2404 (communication section). cite.py: OK §1985:X.1.3.6 GR2; OK §1985:X.4.6.3 SR1; OK §1985:X.1.3.3; OK §1985:X.4.6.4 GR1.
